fidelity_notes.auth: Remove original auth endpoint code; the host auth provider owns submissions, sessions, OAuth and safe redirects.
fidelity_notes.global: Header/footer mounted through cms_globals; site menu, logo, contact data are references, not global hardcoded IAM data.
fidelity_notes.showcase: Four sections share visual tokens but are independently editable; five vignette cards are repeatable blocks.
fidelity_notes.mode_lab: Do not install lab shell; extract nine named loading patterns and mode palette.
fidelity_notes.globe: Unpacked D3/TopoJSON resource into independently licensed dependencies; the original one-file bundler is not a reusable runtime.
